checkpoint: profile gold_001, second client turn before appraisal

concrete supplied trait/background evidence for selections
routing relevance distinguished from deciding new appraisal/behavior
new evidence or unresolved issue motivates reconsideration
supported final choices, no invented facts or unjustified certainty

one sample per wording, fixed seed is not a causal guarantee
